# Meteor Dodge

Pilot a ship across an endless starfield, collect glowing orbs for points. Use arrow keys or WASD to move. Meteors spawn randomly; colliding with any meteor ends the game. Simple shapes rendered on an HTML canvas.

1: // game.js – Meteor Dodge
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) { console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Full‑screen canvas with starfield background
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
10:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
11:   };
12:   resize();
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14: 
15:   // Starfield background
16:   const stars = [];
17:   const STAR_COUNT = 200;
18:   const initStars = () => {
19:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
20:       stars.push({
21:         x: rand(0, canvas.width),
22:         y: rand(0, canvas.height),
23:         size: rand(0.5, 2),
24:         speed: rand(0.2, 0.6)
25:       });
26:     }
27:   };
28:   initStars();
29: 
30:   // Game state
31:   const state = {
32:     ship: { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 60, size: 20, speed: 5 },
33:     keys: {},
34:     meteors: [],
35:     orbs: [],
36:     score: 0,
37:     over: false,
38:     lastMeteor: 0,
39:     lastOrb: 0,
40:   };
41: 
42:   // Input handling (arrow keys & WASD)
43:   const keyMap = {
44:     ArrowLeft: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', ArrowUp: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down',
45:     a: 'left', d: 'right', w: 'up', s: 'down'
46:   };
47:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
48:     // Resume audio context on first user interaction
49:     if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
50:       audioCtx.resume();
51:     }
52:     const dir = keyMap[e.key];
53:     if (dir) state.keys[dir] = true;
54:   });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
56:     const dir = keyMap[e.key];
57:     if (dir) state.keys[dir] = false;
58:   });
59: 
60:   // Utility
61:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
62:   const distance = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2);
63: 
64:   // Audio setup
65:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
66:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
67:   const playTone = (freq, dur) => {
68:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
69:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
70:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
71:     osc.type = 'sine';
72:     osc.connect(gain);
73:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
74:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
75:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
76:     osc.start();
77:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
78:   };
79: 
80:   // Game objects
81:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
82:     const radius = rand(15, 30);
83:     state.meteors.push({
84:       x: rand(radius, canvas.width - radius),
85:       y: -radius,
86:       r: radius,
87:       speed: rand(2, 5)
88:     });
89:   };
90: 
91:   const spawnOrb = () => {
92:     const radius = 8;
93:     state.orbs.push({
94:       x: rand(radius, canvas.width - radius),
95:       y: -radius,
96:       r: radius,
97:       speed: rand(1, 3)
98:     });
99:   };
100: 
101:   // Main loop
102:   const update = (now) => {
103:     if (state.over) {
104:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
105:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
106:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
107:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
108:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
109:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
110:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
111:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
112:       return;
113:     }
114: 
115:     // Move ship
116:     const { ship, keys } = state;
117:     if (keys.left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
118:     if (keys.right) ship.x += ship.speed;
119:     if (keys.up) ship.y -= ship.speed;
120:     if (keys.down) ship.y += ship.speed;
121:     // Keep inside bounds
122:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.size, ship.x));
123:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.size, ship.y));
124: 
125:     // Spawn meteors/orbs over time
126:     if (now - state.lastMeteor > 800) { spawnMeteor(); state.lastMeteor = now; }
127:     if (now - state.lastOrb > 1500) { spawnOrb(); state.lastOrb = now; }
128: 
129:     // Update meteors
130:     state.meteors.forEach(m => m.y += m.speed);
131:     // Remove off‑screen meteors
132:     state.meteors = state.meteors.filter(m => m.y - m.r < canvas.height);
133: 
134:     // Update and collect orbs
135:     state.orbs.forEach(o => o.y += o.speed);
136:     state.orbs = state.orbs.filter(o => {
137:       if (o.y - o.r > canvas.height) return false;
138:       // collision with ship
139: if (distance(o.x, o.y, ship.x, ship.y) < o.r + ship.size) {
140:           state.score++;
141:           // Play a pleasant tone for collecting an orb
142:           playTone(600, 0.1);
143:           return false; // collected
144:         }
145:       return true;
146:     });
147: 
148:     // Collision detection (ship vs meteors)
149:     for (const m of state.meteors) {
150: if (distance(m.x, m.y, ship.x, ship.y) < m.r + ship.size) {
151:           // Play a crash tone
152:           playTone(200, 0.4);
153:           state.over = true;
154:           break;
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:     // Render
159:     // Dark space background with gradient
160:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
161:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#000020');
162:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000060');
163:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
164:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
165:     // Update and draw stars
166:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
167:     for (const s of stars) {
168:       s.y += s.speed;
169:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
170:         s.y = 0;
171:         s.x = rand(0, canvas.width);
172:       }
173:       ctx.beginPath();
174:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
175:       ctx.fill();
176:     }
177:     // Ship – simple triangle with gradient
178:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y - ship.size, ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
179:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
180:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
181:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
182:     ctx.beginPath();
183:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
184:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
185:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
186:     ctx.closePath();
187:     ctx.fill();
188: 
189:     // Meteors with radial gradient
190:     for (const m of state.meteors) {
191:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, m.r * 0.2, m.x, m.y, m.r);
192:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff9966');
193:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#331100');
194:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
195:       ctx.beginPath();
196:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
197:       ctx.fill();
198:     }
199: 
200:     // Orbs
201:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
202:     for (const o of state.orbs) {
203:       ctx.beginPath();
204:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
205:       ctx.fill();
206:     }
207: 
208:     // Score display
209:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
210:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
211:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, 10, 30);
212: 
213:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
214:   };
215: 
216:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
217: })();

(End of file - total 217 lines)
</content>
